output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.shipping_fee), 2) AS total_shipping_fees_eur
FROM marts.fct_orders o
WHERE o.is_revenue = true
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Sums shipping_fee from fct_orders for orders with is_revenue = true (status = 'completed') and order_date in calendar 2025 (fiscal year equals calendar year). Shipping fees are not revenue, but the question asks for fees on completed orders, so the completed-status filter is applied while the fees themselves are summed separately from net revenue.
